whereabouts: Vauthier was at the dinner table when the temple bell struck nine, and the watches were put on the cloth
Aurèle went down the table examining the guests' watches after the bell struck nine
Vauthier and Odile played piquet in the salon after dinner until a quarter to eleven
Vauthier went out to the hall after 10:45 to fetch his cigar case from his coat
Madame (Odile) began playing the piano as Vauthier went out, and stopped when he came back
Vauthier came back to the salon and sat down again before the hall clock struck eleven
